shortDescription: List Pritunl Organizations using the Pritunl API

options.name: organization
options.description: Name of the Pritunl organization to search for. If none provided, the module returns all Pritunl organizations.

options.name: pritunl_api_secret
options.description: API Secret found in Administrators > USERNAME > API Secret.

options.name: pritunl_api_token
options.description: API Token of a Pritunl admin user. It needs to be enabled in Administrators > USERNAME > Enable Token Authentication.

options.name: pritunl_url
options.description: URL and port of the Pritunl server on which the API is enabled.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If certificates should be validated or not. This should never be set to V(false), except if you are very sure that your connection to the server can not be subject to a Man In The Middle attack.
